say:3:1421443001:1.text: Indris seems troubled, likely moved by what Ravion experienced along the way.
say:3:1421443001:1.source_cn: 大约受到沙利叶一路而来经历的触动，因度厄看起来有些心事重重。
say:3:1421443001:1.male: Indris seems troubled, likely moved by what Ravion experienced along the way.
say:3:1421443001:1.female: Indris seems troubled, likely moved by what Ravion experienced along the way.

say:4:1421443002:1.text: What's wrong? Surely you didn't take my jest to heart?
say:4:1421443002:1.source_cn: 怎么了？一副苦大仇深的表情，你该不会把我刚刚的玩笑话当...

say:5:1421443003:0.text: No, I know you were joking. But... it did make me think. Am I really the right one to lead?
say:5:1421443003:0.source_cn: 不，我知道你是在开玩笑。但我也认真地在想，我是不是真的...

say:6:1421443004:1.text: Back when I was captain of the guard, I took pride in spotting lies, reading the noble games played behind closed doors.
say:6:1421443004:1.source_cn: 还在做追捕工作的时候，我以为我已经很了解那些勾心斗角的...

say:7:1421443005:1.text: But this? Factions, faith, class tensions—it's a tangled mess I was never trained to navigate.
say:7:1421443005:1.source_cn: 但如今走到台前来，人们的算计，势力、阶级与信仰的关系，...

say:8:1421443006:1.text: Ah, so you'd rather I reclaim my crown? Since I handle this chaos with such grace?
say:8:1421443006:1.source_cn: 所以，你觉得应对这些游刃有余的我，更适合回归以前的头衔了？

say:9:1421443007:1.text: That's not what I meant. It's just... you understand this world—and you don't despise its people. That's what matters. You adapt. You're clever.
say:9:1421443007:1.source_cn: 嗯，至少你对这些民众并没有满怀恶意，但又比我更圆滑，更...

say:10:1421443008:1.text: Careful, dear Indris—flatter me too lavishly, and I might start believing it. But truly—who do you think taught me any of that? It wasn't Velara, bless her fanatical little heart. No, it was my mother.
say:10:1421443008:1.source_cn: 那么，你知道我是跟谁学到这些的吗？当然不是奎茵那个疯子...

say:11:1421443009:1.text: Though, how much was truly taught... and how much I learned on my own is debatable. Tell me, would you call her a good ruler?
say:11:1421443009:1.source_cn: 先不去计较有多少言传身教和多少自学成才吧，你觉得，我母...

say:12:1421443010:1.text:
...
Once, I thought her magnificent. Later, I decided she was a monster.
say:12:1421443010:1.source_cn: …………\n我曾经，觉得她很伟大，后面又觉得她非常邪恶。

say:13:1421443011:1.text: But after everything I've seen—facing the dragon, watching what's become of the people...
say:13:1421443011:1.source_cn: 但，经历过目前的这一切，目睹过龙的腾飞，与她亲自战斗过...

say:14:1421443012:1.text: Now? I'm starting to think she might have been... extraordinary.
say:14:1421443012:1.source_cn: 我又开始不禁觉得，她作为领袖，很……出色。

choice_prompt:15:1421443012.text: Now? I'm starting to think she might have been... extraordinary.
choice_prompt:15:1421443012.source_cn: 我又开始不禁觉得，她作为领袖，很……出色。

say:16:1421443013:2.text: I read her records. Her final testament.
say:16:1421443013:2.source_cn: 但是，看了她的手记和遗嘱，里面记载的这些内容。

say:17:1421443014:1.text: She had Sage Tasso executed. Used her own child like a pawn. Chose the fates of her most loyal—and most dangerous—followers with chilling precision, right before her death.
say:17:1421443014:1.source_cn: 暗杀贤者，把子嗣当成工具，在濒死时毫不留情地决定自己最...

say:18:1421443015:1.text: Then carried on as if it meant nothing. Only to turn on her own successor not long after.
say:18:1421443015:1.source_cn: 而在事后又自然而然地当做什么都没发生，转而对自己的继任...

say:19:1421443016:1.text: The deeper I dig, the more her ruthless brilliance comes into focus—and <style="highlight">it chills me</style>.
say:19:1421443016:1.source_cn: 我愈发会感觉，这是一位冷静至极的出色领袖——但与此同时...

say:20:1421443017:1.text: She terrifies me more than the corruption, more than the dragon—more than the dead gods themselves.
say:20:1421443017:1.source_cn: 比孽化，比龙，比神明，比算计千年的阴谋，比扭曲的统治这...

say:21:1421443018:1.text: And that, dear general, is exactly why you should be leading Sal'thorin.
say:21:1421443018:1.source_cn: 嗯，所以，因度厄，这就是你比我更适合当领导者——至少是...

say:22:1421443019:1.text: Because you still <style="highlight">fear</style> those things. I don't. I simply understand them, and move through them like water.
say:22:1421443019:1.source_cn: 因为你还会对这些事情<style=highlight>...

say:23:1421443020:1.text: With you at the helm, I'll stand watch at the dragon's essence pool, ready to destroy it if it comes to that.
say:23:1421443020:1.source_cn: 因为你在这里，我会看守龙蛋液池，并随时做好毁灭它的准备。

say:24:1421443021:1.text: But if I were in charge? I'd invite a few allies to take a sip. Let them soak up its power, leash them tight—and watch the corruption devour them when they've served their purpose.
say:24:1421443021:1.source_cn: 但如果是我，我会立刻安排我需要拉拢的人进来享受，巩固我...

say:25:1421443022:1.text: I'd keep the Sylvan Tendril as a weapon, even if it meant listening to patients scream in agony.
say:25:1421443022:1.source_cn: 织叶我会控制在自己手中，作为新的掌控手段——即使有无数...

say:26:1421443023:1.text: But you're the one who said you wanted to change Sal'thorin. Lead everyone back to the surface—
say:26:1421443023:1.source_cn: 但你说过，你也想要改变萨洛克兰，带领大家回归地面——

choice_prompt:27:1421443023.text: But you're the one who said you wanted to change Sal'thorin. Lead everyone back to the surface—
choice_prompt:27:1421443023.source_cn: 但你说过，你也想要改变萨洛克兰，带领大家回归地面——

say:28:1421443024:1.text: Exactly. And to reach my end, I'd sacrifice anything.
say:28:1421443024:1.source_cn: 是的，为了达成目标，我会不择手段。
say:28:1421443024:1.male: Exactly. And to reach my end, I'd sacrifice anything.
say:28:1421443024:1.female: Exactly. And to reach my end, I'd sacrifice anything.

say:29:1421443026:1.text: Then it would all be meaningless. A kingdom built on ash is still ash.
say:29:1421443026:1.source_cn: 但那样的话，我们的行动就没有意义了。

say:30:1421443027:1.text: Precisely. And that's the difference between us, Indris.
say:30:1421443027:1.source_cn: 正是如此，因度厄，这就是我和你的区别。

say:31:1421443028:2.text: The records were right—I was born to be a vessel for twisted magic. A living compromise. And I survived by bending, by becoming what the world demanded.
say:31:1421443028:2.source_cn: 就像那些记录，我最初只是作为承载变异魔力的扭曲子嗣而诞...

say:32:1421443029:1.text: You'd pity me, maybe rage for me. But when I uncovered my history? I felt joy.
say:32:1421443029:1.source_cn: 你会为我感到悲伤和愤怒，但我看到来龙去脉的时候，我居然...

say:33:1421443030:1.text: I am the tainted fruit of Seralyth's thorned vine, nourished on rot and secrets.
say:33:1421443030:1.source_cn: 我是奈萨雷斯这朵流淌着毒液的花朵结下的扭曲的果实，并且...

say:34:1421443031:1.text: But you? You're sunlight, Indris. And down here, in this cursed dark, you're the only light left.
say:34:1421443031:1.source_cn: 而你不一样，因度厄，你是太阳。至少在这片黑暗的地下，你...

say:35:1421443032:1.text: There is no worthier leader than you, Indris.
say:35:1421443032:1.source_cn: 没有人比你更适合成为领导者了，因度厄。

say:36:1421443033:1.text: Walk this path with us, and from this soil, cultivate blossoms of a truer dawn.
say:36:1421443033:1.source_cn: 就这样带领我们在这片土地上，开出全新的……真正的花朵吧。

choice:27:0:1.text: The means aren't the same as the end.
choice:27:0:1.male: The means aren't the same as the end.
choice:27:0:1.female: The means aren't the same as the end.

say:38:1421443025:1.text: Our goals don't differ. But you know my path would be quicker.
say:38:1421443025:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们的目标并无不同，但你得承认，照我的法子办，速...

choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 为了效率而牺牲一部分
